blocks.text: Rio de Janeiro: Sugarloaf Mountain and the historic centre

provenance.rationale: The day heading gives the city, and the accompanying itinerary identifies the two stops needed in the website title.

blocks.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Half-day excursion to the Sugar Loaf with a guide. The first stop is the mountain Urca, with wide viewing area, where you can eat in a restaurant or have a drink at the bar. The mountain Sugar Loaf offers a beautiful view of Rio, Copacabana beach, the bay, the surrounding mountains, the islands in the ocean, bridge Niteroi, a statue of Christ. Then you will go by car to the central regions of the old Rio, where you can admire several ancient churches, monasteries, the main cathedral of the city, as well as buildings, built in colonial style.

blocks.text: Rio de Janeiro: Corcovado and Christ the Redeemer

provenance.rationale: Combine the Word day heading with the two named landmarks in its itinerary paragraph to form the site title.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, you’ll set out on a city tour with an English-speaking guide.

You’ll pass through central Rio, with its historic churches, monasteries and colonial architecture. Then you’ll head to the station for the train through Tijuca Forest to the top of Corcovado.

Tijuca Forest surrounds the railway and is home to monkeys, birds and other local wildlife.

At about 700 m above sea level stands the 38 m statue of Christ the Redeemer, erected in 1931. From the summit you can see Guanabara Bay, the Niterói Bridge, the Botanical Garden, Maracanã Stadium, Sugarloaf Mountain and the city’s neighbourhoods. The view shows how Rio lies between the ocean, bays and granite peaks.
